metadata.scoringImplementation: Independent Dart port using production LocalTokenizer, Bm25Index, QueryAnalysis, corpus/chunk/training assets, and precomputed production ONNX query vectors.

preprocessing.used: Offline production path; BM25 includes original query and query_analysis glossary expansion.

legacyDenseOnly.note: The saved legacy evaluation returns only three results; Hit@15 is therefore its all-results hit count.

chunkTokenization.note: Corpus chunks were exported with a 256-token limit; query and training examples use 128. This counts source chunks before embedding and is not itself proof of a retrieval error.

queryDomainAudit.note: Evaluation-domain categories are only a coarse comparison to the production QueryDomain. A mismatch is not by itself proof that the query classifier is legally wrong.
